column1: # r11 (ATM-1217 review F5): the expected sha256 of the units helper binary, per source hash (sha256 over units_helper/
# except this file, as _units_source_hash computes it) and go toolchain. The build is reproducible (-trimpath,
# -buildvcs=false, CGO_ENABLED=0, -mod=vendor; measured: two builds from empty GOCACHE dirs give the same bytes).
# On a listed toolchain a cached or freshly built binary with any other sha256 is refused; an unlisted toolchain
# is accepted on the recomputed stamp only (stated limit). Columns: source-hash go-version goos/goarch binary-sha256
